lines.en: : Come to think of it, why is everyone always taking me on trips to bond with me? Can I not be bonded with from the comfort of my own home?
: No. Because that is where your father lives. And so long as he is present, you are unbondable.
: Unless it’s bond-age. I’ve found that that’s best done from the comfort of one’s own home as it’s an inherently safer environment that’s easier to establish boundaries in.
: See, Aunt Niki? If you want to tie me up and do things to me, at least let me stay in bed for it. How do you expect me to accept you as a mother if you can’t even do that much?
: Thank you, Noriko. Now Ami completely understands what this trip is all about. And here I was worried all the ropes and shackles would intimidate her.
: They might at first, but only because all of my experience with stuff like that is on the opposite end.
: Who was the person you tied up, Ami?
: Maya.
: Lucky! I want to do that! Then she’d be forced to like me or she’d have to stay my prisoner forever.
: Maya’s that girl who has a crush on Akira, right?
: You could say that about literally everyone I know and you’d still be correct.
: No, I mean the one who threw a temper tantrum and stormed out of the house on Halloween. She was dressed up as Haruhi Suzumiya, wasn’t she?
: Oh, yeah. That’s Maya alright. Leave it to her to pick someone as dated as Haruhi Suzumiya. She’s like one Halloween off from going as Kagome or something.
: Are you trying to start a fight with me, child?
: Don’t feel bad, Nee-chan! I personally love how you’re stuck in the era you grew up in.
: It makes me feel less weird about the dramatic gap in time between the unprotected sex our parents had when they were creating us.
: Thank you, Noriko. I’m very glad you reminded me of our parents having unprotected sex. Make that two times today I have had to think of our father in that context now.
: Well jeez, Nee-chan. I know you love our dad, I just didn’t realize you loved him that much.
: THAT’S NOT WHAT I MEANT!
: Sex with dads and how okay it is aside, I’m excited for this trip! I had a ton of fun with Sara when I went camping last time, so maybe this’ll be just as good?
: Sara? Who is Sara? What is Sara? Why is Sara? Why did you go camping with her?
: A friend’s mom. She’s the one who cut my hair. Super nice lady. Loves my dad maybe just as much as you do, Aunt Niki.
: Well I’m sure she’s a very nice lady.
: Ooooh, Nee-chan’s jealous now.
: Really? But why would Niki be jealous of a super nice and motherly woman who has already spent time bonding with me and reminding me of how a mother’s touch feels?
: I’m not jealous at all! I mean...I’m a famous idol. And she’s your friend’s mother, so of course she’s already spoken for. There’s nothing for me to be jealous of.
: Actually, Sara’s husband walked out on her a long time ago. She’s single now. And desperately looking for a new man to take care of her daughter.
: Is she fat?
: Nee-chan! That’s mean!
: What?! I’m allowed to ask!
: She’s not! She’s actually really small and super pretty! She could probably pass as a teenager if she really wanted to.
: FUCK!
: Patrice! Pull over!
: I can’t. There’s no shoulder. And I’m not going to just let you go out of the car to throw a tantrum. We’re on a highway. That’s a PR disaster waiting to happen.
: You’re only saying that because you’ve never been in love, you fucking whore! Drive us off a cliff then! That’ll teach that bastard to bring other moms into the picture!
: Uhh...Nee-chan? When you say “other moms,” could it be that you’re forgetting you’re not one of those? Unless- ah! You’re pregante!
: Aunt Niki’s prangent?! Since when?!
: I am not pergenat! I’m just leaving open the possibility that one day, I might be?
: Why can’t any of you pronounce the word “pregnant?”
: Have you never been on the fucking Internet before, Patrice?! Pull over!
: To use the Internet?
: No! To throw yourself into the ocean, you slimy cunt!
And so the car was ultimately brought to a stop just five minutes from the girls’ final destination.

With her manager hovering over her and shielding her from the passing cars, dashcams, and prying eyes, Niki then proceeded to curse her childhood friend to a lifetime worth of erectile dysfunction whenever she wasn’t around.
Of course, this would very much not be the case. And he would proceed to have erections around basically everyone because that’s just the kind of guy he was.
On the inside of the limo, though, an awkward silence took the place of the girl who occupied the middle seat just seconds ago.
Because, while Noriko was brought along to cultivate a more bond-friendly environment, the truth was she still didn’t know how to feel about Ami.
But Ami knew how to feel about her.
And what Noriko did not yet understand is that, for perhaps the first time ever, she’d be on the receiving end of what could only be called “faith.”
Not faith in a god. Not faith in a friend. Not even faith in what was now essentially family.
Just faith that she’d fulfill the role she needed to fill to keep the wheels of time spinning while everything else has stopped.
A pencil in the hand of God is as good as a pen in the hand of the Pope.
But when both of those tools are taken away, only one can write in blood.
The other must simply watch.
: Having some trouble there, Patrice?
: I’m honestly just surprised you only brought one bag.
: There are ten more in the car.
: Niki, we’re here for one weekend...
: I know. I just thought you could use the exercise. Aren’t I the nicest client you’ve ever had?
: Hah...I’ll be back with everything else in a minute. But remember, we have a meeting with the photographer in-
: Yeah, yeah. Fuck off. Thanks!
: Poor Patrice. What did she ever do to anybody?
: Didn’t you threaten to kill her the last time you guys met?
: Oh, yeah...I guess I did.
: You have a meeting already, Nee-chan? You don’t even get to settle in first?
: It shouldn’t take long. I just have to go sign off on a few swimsuits. Make sure nothing’s too revealing or we might sell too many calendars and I’ll suddenly be drowning in money.
: This might be a weird question, but have you ever imagined how much you’d make if you did porn?
: Not really. I’m too successful to have ever considered pivoting to that. I’m sure the offers will start rolling in once I’m retired, though.
: I’m already getting them.
: What? From who?
: Probably a bunch of companies who want to hire you and don’t realize how old I am. Social media’s a cesspool nowadays, Onee-chan.
: Give me your phone. I don’t want those weirdos contacting you anymore.
: I can’t. There are too many nudes of Kirin in there and I don’t want you seeing them despite how badly she probably wants you to.
: Ugh...fine. Whatever. Just don’t fucking respond to any of those people, okay? I’ll have failed as a sister if you start doing porn. Which isn’t even mentioning how it could impact my career.
: That was such a good opportunity to remind me how much you love me and you squandered it. Who am I to you, Nee-chan? Patrice?
: No. But you are a babysitter until I get back. Now, watch Ami and make sure she doesn’t contact Akira.
: Okay!
: Noriko’s not even that much older than me!
: True! But Noriko doesn’t want to fuck her dad, so she’s clearly the more mature out of you! Be back soon!
: It’s 2020. How are there still girls out there who don’t want to fuck their dad?
: I want to fuck your dad. Does that count?
: Close enough, I guess. I’m sure you will sooner or later too. I’m done trying to stop people from doing it.
: Wait, you are? Since when? How did that happen? This wasn’t just some extremely long, extremely creepy phase, was it?
: Of course not. There’s just no way for me to get what I want by interfering anymore.
: And...what is it you want, Ami?
: Well, for one, I’d like Niki to stop trying to be my new mother when I already have a perfectly good one.
: You mean...Sara? Is that why you brought her up earlier? Cause it...did seem like you were trying to make her jealous. But I just thought-
: I’m not talking about Sara. I’m talking about my mom. The same one I’ve always had.
: Uhh...Ami? I don’t know how to break this to you, but-
: I know she’s dead, okay? But that doesn’t mean I’m okay with just replacing her. There are things she can still teach me from wherever she is now.
: She left a lot behind. Myself included, obviously. Someone trying to fill her shoes will only distract me from that.
: Nee-chan would never try to replace her though, Ami. She-
: I know. She said that herself. But it still doesn’t change the fact that she’s poking her nose where she shouldn’t. And she keeps trying to change me when my mom never would.
: I mean...l was still super little when your mom was around, but I’m pretty sure she wouldn’t be okay with her daughter trying to fuck her brother-in-law.
: She was taken away too soon, so I guess we’ll never really know. But I do know that the thought alone wouldn’t disturb her the way it does Niki.
: My mom understood the strange, sometimes carnal bonds two people who don’t belong together can have. She wouldn’t think I’m broken. Niki does.
: But what Niki doesn’t understand is that being “broken” is just an Arakawa family trait. We’re all like that.
: She does understand that, though. That’s why she tries so hard to make things better for you and Nii-chan.
: But that’s her idea of better. Not ours. And forcing that on us the way she does isn’t going to do anything but hurt her in the long run.
: Is it just me...or are you, like...way smarter all of a sudden?
: It’s just you! The only thing inside my head is spending time with my dad. So of course I’ll sound smarter when the conversation is centered around that.
: I still need Makoto’s help for math and stuff, though. So don’t worry, Noriko! You’re still smarter than me!
: Are you...happy, Ami?
: Sometimes. Sometimes, not. How about you?
: Sometimes...
: I doubt you actually care though...and you’re only just asking me because I asked you.
: Well, on that note, do you actually care about me?
: Or do you only have to care about me because your “Nii-chan” does?
: I wouldn’t have asked you if you were happy if I didn’t care.
: I do.
: I shouldn’t, but I do.
: And I want you as a sister just as badly as Nee-chan wants you as a daughter, but I feel like there’s nothing either one of us can do to ever have you let us into your life that way.
: Why...would you want me as a sister? What do I bring to the table besides my dad?
: Well, for one, it would be nice not secretly thinking you want to disembowel me all the time. But more than that...I don’t know.
: I just feel like we’re supposed to be closer than we are. Like it’s weird that we’re the same age and Akira is the one I’m attached to.
: Like, maybe if we met each other more when we were little, things would be different now? And I wouldn’t be as afraid of you as...as I am.
: See? That. That...blank stare. I never know what you’re thinking. I never know if things are going well when I talk to you anymore. You’re just...I can’t tell what’s real and what’s not.
: That’s not your fault, Noriko.
: I’ve just made too many mistakes to ever give away what I’m really feeling anymore.
: But I’m glad you- wait.
: Dad?
: Hello.
: N-N-NII-CHAN?!?!?! WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?! I TOLD YOU THAT THIS NEEDED TO BE A STEALTH OPERATION AND YOU’RE JUST BARGING IN?!
: Yeah. I’m not good at stealth.
: SO YOU OPEN UP THE POSSIBILITY FOR ME TO BE SACRIFICED TO A DEMON?!
: Oh, right. I forgot that was the penalty for this.
: Wait, I’m confused. Noriko, did you invite him? Because I was going to invite him as soon as I had a chance. But-
: I TOLD YOU, PATRICE! NO ICE! THERE’S LESS DRINK IF THERE’S ICE! SERIOUSLY, WHAT ARE YOU EVEN GOOD FOR?!
: SAVE YOUR QUESTIONS! IT’S TIME TO HIDE!
: AND NOW IT’S TIME TO DESTROY!
: Yeah! How dare you accept Noriko’s invitation and not the one I wanted to make but haven't had the chance to yet!
: Now it’s going to look like she’s the one who wanted you here more and that’s simply not true!
: Okay, sorry. But do you guys really need to pin me up against the wall to yell at me?
: Of course we do! There’s no room in here!
: There’s tons of room. Just look. You don’t need to-
: It’s so cramped in here!
: Yeah! I can barely move!
: Seriously?
: Wait — shh. I don’t know how familiar you are with Nakayama Sister Law. But 19A-B-42L states-
: Demon sacrifice. I know.
: You’ve been studying. I like it.

: Yeah, no problem. Now, can somebody explain to me what’s going on? Because it’s starting to look like you invited my dad here so you wouldn’t have to be the third wheel while Aunt Niki tries to bond with me.
: No! I-
: Oh. Actually, yeah. That’s exactly what happened.
: What the heck, Noriko?! There’s no way I’m going to be able to escape from your sister once she gets back! How am I supposed to live knowing my dad is so close but I can’t reach him?!
: The same way you live knowing he’s boning my sister every night while you do your homework.
: By masturbating and wishing it was me instead?! Also, it's very bold of you to assume I do my homework!
: I had to masturbate to them for years, damn it! Don’t tell me you’re throwing in the towel already, weakling!
: Aaaaah but it’s so hard! I can’t take it anymore!
: Well, take it for a little while longer because now is my time to shine, sister!
: Noriko? Ami? Are you...both in there?
: J...Just a second?!
: Yeah! We’re...almost done!
: With what?
: Now look what you two have done.
: Us?! This is all your fault, Nii-chan! If you had only waited another ten minutes, you wouldn’t be getting assaulted right now and I wouldn’t be a sacrifice!
: Hah...I have an idea.
: All I ask...
: Is that you do not forget this sacrifice...
: Ami? Where are you-
: The time has come...for Ami Arakawa...
: To do something good...
